resources.string: Gentle AA smooths edges while preserving more original detail. Menu and wrist HUD stay sharp. Default off; takes effect on the next game start.
Data release %1$s is installed. Update the online game data once so Quest can check PC compatibility.
To join Windows games, enable PC play and install Online game data. Both devices must use the same GeneralsOnline data release.

Uses the PC checksum from Online game data and switches Quest to 60 Hz on the next game start. Install or update Online game data here; no manual INI copy is needed. Run the PC without Easy Anti-Cheat; GeneralsOnline AntiCheat may remain enabled.
For cross-play, run the PC without Easy Anti-Cheat. GeneralsOnline AntiCheat may remain enabled.
Removes fine ground and mountain patterns for comparison. Takes effect on the next full game start.

Filters ground and mountain patterns for a steadier distant view; terrain may look softer. Menus and objects remain unchanged. Set Terrain pattern test to Original; applies on the next full game start.
Trilinear smooths texture-level transitions. Edge guard also reduces oblique texture sampling; may calm ground seams but soften angled surfaces. Applies on the next full game start.
Higher per-eye resolution for finer detail and edges. 1.5× draws about 2.25 times as many pixels and may reduce FPS. Device limits apply. Takes effect on the next full game start.
Uses all available reduced road texture levels for distant sampling. Original near texture and terrain atlas stay intact. Full restart required.
Rebuilds reduced alpha coverage in selected vegetation and railing textures. Fine details may look denser; not every tree texture is covered. Full restart required.
Blends transparent contours of the tree atlas and selected foliage/railings. Overlaps can look different and GPU cost can rise. Keeps roads, terrain and HUD intact. Full restart required.
Reduces allocations while decoding sounds. Same audio output; mainly tests first-use hitches. Full restart required.
Skips an identical second-eye track upload after comparing actual vertices. Keeps both eye draws. Full restart required.
Reuses identical terrain-transition lighting within one stereo pair. Scene lights use the original path. Full restart required.
Updates only the changed visible vertex interval of pushed/toppled trees. Animation timing stays unchanged. Full restart required.
Appends the second eye to available shadow-buffer space; overflow retains the original discard path. Full restart required.
Shares one edge buffer between sequential eyes of the same frame slot. Same SMAA quality; lower intermediate memory, FPS gain unknown. Only effective with SMAA. Full restart required.
Logs frame-interval percentiles and stage times every 120 stereo frames. Keep enabled in both comparison runs. Full restart required.
Uses the same wind movement in both eyes. Trees still sway. Full restart required.
Softens tree texture patterns and transparent contours. Trees may look softer or thinner. Keeps terrain and roads intact. Full restart required.
Softens supported railing patterns and transparent edges. Fences may look softer or thinner. Full restart required.
Draws building and unit shadows. Default off; may reduce FPS. Automatic quality reduction can temporarily suppress shadows under load. Applies on the next game start.
Edge guard, distant ground filtering, road mipmaps, audio loading and vehicle/tree upload optimizations are applied automatically.
If you like this Quest VR port, you can buy SuperS92 a coffee on Ko-Fi. Support is entirely optional.

Draws unchanged ground patches in fewer submissions. Default Off. Compare the same scene with performance metrics enabled; fully close the game and launcher after changing. Online compatibility must be retested.

1. Copy your own Generals and Zero Hour game files to the Quest.

2. Choose “Select Zero Hour folder” and import the Zero Hour folder. Then choose “Select Generals base folder” and import the Generals folder.

3. “Play” starts the game. See the project for VR controls.

4. “View logs” helps with problems. Check logs for personal information before sharing them publicly.

Videos, menus and the 3D intro use a fixed flat screen with the original game camera. Matches remain stereo VR. Press the left menu button to recenter. Fully close the game and launcher after changing.

Quest app updates come from SuperS92/GeneralsZH-QuestVR-Port. Download here, then confirm installation on the headset. Game data and settings are kept. Signed network settings still come from the Android base; online game data is updated under GeneralsOnline Settings.
